sentences.text: Longicatena caecimuris has been isolated from a healthy human Japanese faecal sample, and the complete genome sequence of that strain was reported.
That genome was described as a circular chromosome of 3,103,757 base pairs with a GC content of 38.3 per cent.
A study of 1134 children aged three to six years reported lower Longicatena caecimuris in stool linked to obesity, using shotgun metagenomic sequencing.
